sections.h2: Where Antrim County property records are kept
sections.html:
Deeds, mortgages and liens on Antrim County land are filed with the Register of Deeds at the county building in Bellaire. The office keeps a grantor and grantee index and serves weekdays from 8:30 to 5:00. The register also chairs the County Plat Board, the body that reviews new subdivisions before they can be sold off in lots.

Bring the original signed deed, the fee and a return address for the recorded copy. Staff index the grantor and grantee names so later title searches can find the deed.

Filings reach back to 1856. Computer images start in January 1990, and older entries sit in bound books. The name index covering the whole life of the county can be searched at no charge at a public terminal, though you reserve a slot by appointment.

Timing matters. Michigan runs a race-notice system, so a recorded deed puts every later buyer on notice, and the office stamps and numbers each paper in the order it lands on the counter. A lake cottage that changes hands in July should have its deed filed the day the money moves.

Antrim charges a flat $30.00 for each document it records, whether the deed runs one page or twelve. A few other items matter at a sale.

  • When one paper handles more than one assignment or discharge, add $3.00 for every instrument past the first.
  • Warranty deeds, any deed carrying a covenant of warranty, and land contracts (plus assignments or amendments that touch the legal description) need a $5.00 treasurer's certificate.
  • Photocopies cost $1.00 a page, plat copies $2.00 a page, and a certified copy costs $5.00 for its first page.

The office accepts a check, cash or a credit card. Make checks out to the Antrim County Register of Deeds, and expect the certificate to be handled through the treasurer's window.

sections.h2: Transfer tax on an Antrim County sale
sections.html:
The tax is charged per $500 of the price, with any leftover fraction counted as a full block, and it is paid at recording. Michigan register offices post a state share of $3.75 per block plus a county share of $0.55, which adds up to $4.30. Ask the Antrim office to confirm its county share before closing. Your bill follows the real sale price on the deed.

The state act lists transfers that owe nothing. The exempt group in MCL 207.526 includes:

  • a gift deed running to a son, daughter, stepchild or grandchild;
  • transfers by foreclosure or by a deed in lieu of foreclosure;
  • court orders that move title without naming a money amount;
  • a quitclaim that repairs a title flaw by confirming what the grantee already holds;
  • any instrument where the price is below $100.

The deed text itself must name the exemption claimed, or the office will collect the tax.

You can do either. The register recommends e-recording through Simplifile or EPN, and still accepts the post office, FedEx, UPS and similar carriers. A drop box at the southeast corner of the county building takes hand deliveries, but it is only checked periodically, so a deed on a closing deadline should go another way.

Slip a return envelope with postage into anything you mail, and the original comes back once it is indexed. Staff can say what a filing needs, yet drafting a deed or picking a form is outside their role.

At a normal sale none of this lands on the seller. The closing agent signs the deed with you, adds the transfer tax and the treasurer's $5.00 certificate, and sends the package in electronically. Owners handling an inherited cabin by hand should call the office before they file.

sections.h2: Property tax bills and old balances
sections.html:
Your village or township bills the year in progress. The County Treasurer takes only earlier years and delinquent accounts. Summer bills go out in July and are due to the village or township on September 14. Township winter tax is billed in December and due February 14.

To pay a past-year balance, send a check to the treasurer at PO Box 544, Bellaire, MI 49615, pay by card online or by phone at 231-533-6720, or use the secure drop box outside the public entrance. Card payments add 2.95 percent, with a $3.99 minimum. People who may qualify for help can ask the treasurer about the Michigan Department of Health and Human Services.

If the parcel carries an unpaid balance, call the treasurer for a payoff figure before the house goes on the market. The closing agent deducts that sum from what you receive, so knowing it early lets you judge your net.

For a standard sale, expect this sequence. The buyer's title company orders a tax search, you sign the deed, the agent collects transfer tax and the $5.00 certificate where one is required, and the package is recorded in Bellaire the same day or close to it. A payoff for an old balance is settled at the same table. If you sell for cash and as-is, the same recording steps apply, but there is usually no lender appraisal or repair request to wait on.

sections.h2: Antrim County housing at a glance
sections.html:
Antrim covers 602 square miles of northwest lower Michigan, and 126 of them are water, with Torch Lake and much of the Chain of Lakes inside the county. Bellaire is the seat. Population is estimated at 24,698 for 2025, and owners occupy 86.4 percent of 11,100 households. Median gross rent is $902 a month and median owner cost with a mortgage is $1,462. A shoreline lot at Elk Rapids and a woodland house near Mancelona sit in different markets, so get comparable sales from the immediate area.

Many houses in the county are seasonal or came through an estate. A place closed up through several winters can need roof, plumbing or septic work before a financed buyer will go ahead. A buyer who takes the house in its current condition skips that repair list, which draws some owners to a cash sale.

faqs.q: What is the filing fee for an Antrim County deed?
faqs.a: The fee is $30.00 for a document of any length. Each extra assignment or discharge on the same paper adds $3.00, and warranty deeds and land contracts also need the $5.00 treasurer's certificate.

faqs.q: Does the Antrim County office take deeds by e-recording?
faqs.a: Yes, through Simplifile or EPN, which the register encourages. Paper still works by mail, by carrier, or through the box at the building's southeast corner.

faqs.q: Which office collects this year's tax on an Antrim County house?
faqs.a: The village or township holds the current year's tax roll. The county treasurer steps in for prior years and delinquent bills, and the due dates for summer and winter township tax are September 14 and February 14.

faqs.q: Will the register's staff prepare my deed?
faqs.a: No. They can describe what the office needs, but writing the deed is left to a preparer you hire. Heirs and sellers working without a closing agent should line one up first.

faqs.q: Is a deed to my daughter taxed as a sale in Antrim County?
faqs.a: MCL 207.526 exempts a parent's conveyance to a child from the state tax, provided the deed names the exemption in its text. Confirm the exact language for the county side with the register before you sign.
